description: Recommend the lowest-cost suitable model and effort on Claude, ChatGPT, Codex, Gemini or Grok from a live guide, with a Revision citation. Guidance updates on use.

interface.shortDescription: Choose models with less waste, on any platform
interface.longDescription: For people who use more than one AI platform. Get a model and effort recommendation for Claude, ChatGPT, Codex, Gemini or Grok from the live Model Value Map. Start with the cheapest suitable listed pick, verify the result and upgrade only after a failed check. One setup prompt adds the guidance to your instructions on each platform and one task per platform that refreshes it every two weeks. Savings depend on the task and are not guaranteed.
interface.defaultPrompt: Recommend a model and effort for my task on this platform using current guidance. Cite the Revision.
